newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China, South Korea end talks on defector.
newsitem.headline: China, South Korea end talks on defector.

text.p: Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen and his South Korean counterpart Yoo Chong-ha ended talks on Friday aimed at resolving a diplomatic crisis over a top North Korean defector, witnesses said.
Yoo told reporters the two men would meet again, but gave no further details on the talks about defector Hwang Jang-yop, who is in the South Korean embassy in Beijing seeking political asylum.
The South Korean minister said the talks, which lasted almost 50 minutes instead of the scheduled 30 minutes, were "good" and added: "Meetings will continue."

Qian suggested it would take more time for Beijing to decide between Pyongyang and Seoul on defector Hwang Jang-yop, a top aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-il, and urged both countries to stay calm.
"We need more time to investigate," Qian told reporters. He urged both Koreas "to treat this matter with a cool and calm manner".
